Black Friday FAQs

When does the Black Friday sale run?

Buy one, get one 40% off runs Wednesday through Sunday at 11:59 p.m. ET, in all nine =PR= stores and online at prrunandwalk.com.

How does buy one, get one 40% off work?

Add two items to your cart and 40% comes off the lower-priced one automatically. No code needed.

Can I mix and match?

Yes. Pair shoes with apparel, apparel with gear, or shoes with more shoes.

Is anything excluded?

Gift cards and race entries, including the =PR= Race Pass.

What's your return policy?

Returns are hassle-free for 30 days. Black Friday purchases follow the same policy.

Do you offer free shipping?

Yes, on all orders over $125.
